newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aero says injection plan possible.
newsitem.headline: China Aero says injection plan possible.

text.p: China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd said on Monday there was a possibility of future projects flowing from its parent China Aerospace Corp (CASC) and of a rights issue by the company.
In a statement, the Hong Kong-listed company said "the possibility of injecting any new projects or rights issues may occur in future".
"However, no obligations or agreements for injecting new projects is underway between our company and CASC nor is there any current plan for a rights issue by our company," it said.
China Aerospace International engages in the manufacture and distribution of electronics and plastic products. It also participates in property investment.
China Aerospace International shares fell HK$0.05 to HK$1.94 in late trade on Monday with 24.36 million shares traded.
